privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Terms
privacy.intro: This page explains what Resume Build AI collects, how it is used, and your choices.
privacy.collected.title: Data we collect
privacy.collected.body: Your name, WhatsApp number, email (optional), college, department and year; your education, skills, languages, projects and awards; your skill test answers and scores; and the job role you choose.
privacy.use.title: How we use it
privacy.use.body: To build your resume, run and score your skill tests, suggest job roles that fit you, and show your progress to your college's placement team if you joined through your college. AI is used to prepare test questions and to tailor your resume wording; it only uses the details you entered.
privacy.whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages
privacy.whatsapp.body:
By creating an account you agree that we send your test results, skill scores, resume link and job or training alerts to your WhatsApp number. Scores below 50% are never shown in these messages.
To stop them, reply STOP to any of our messages, or turn off WhatsApp updates on your resume page.
privacy.sharing.title: Who we share it with
privacy.sharing.body: We do not sell your data. It is stored with our hosting and database providers, sent to our AI provider only to prepare tests and resume text, and sent to our WhatsApp provider only to deliver your messages. If you joined through your college, its placement team can see your profile, scores and resume.
privacy.rights.title: Your choices
privacy.rights.body: You can edit your profile at any time, hide your score percentages on your resume, and stop WhatsApp messages. To delete your account and data, contact us.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: Questions or requests about your data:
